map.通过差减法估算氮磷钾肥料的当季利用率，评估施肥方案合理性: Estimate current-season recovery of NPK fertilizers by the difference method and assess plan rationality
map.当季利用率 = (施肥区吸收量 − 对照区吸收量) ÷ 施入养分量 × 100%: Current-season recovery = (fertilized uptake - control uptake) / applied nutrient x 100%
map.经典差减法：以不施肥的对照区吸收量为本底，施肥区吸收量减本底即肥料贡献量，除以施: Classic difference method: the unfertilized control uptake is the baseline; fertilized uptake minus baseline is the fertilizer contribution, divided by applied nutrient for current-season recovery. Grade by nutrient type (N/P/K) against reference ranges (high/normal/low) and give advice like split application, deep placement, and organic co-application.
map.农学利用率 = (施肥产量 − 空白产量) / 施肥量。: Agronomic efficiency = (fertilized yield - blank yield) / applied amount.
map.或养分吸收利用率 = (施肥吸养 − 空白吸养) / 施肥量。: Or nutrient recovery efficiency = (fertilized uptake - blank uptake) / applied amount.
map.用于减肥增效与施肥方式优化评估。: Used for fertilizer reduction and application-method optimization.
map.施 N 15 kg/亩比空白增产 180 kg/亩籽粒，农学利用率 = 180/: Applied N 15 kg/mu raised grain 180 kg/mu over blank; agronomic efficiency = 180/15 = 12 kg grain/kg N. With grain N content, nutrient recovery about 35%~40%, suggesting deep placement can raise it further.
map.农学利用率和养分利用率哪个更直观？: Which is more intuitive, agronomic or nutrient recovery?
map.农学利用率（kg 粮/kg 肥）农民好懂，反映『投入产出』；养分利用率是生理口径: Agronomic efficiency (kg grain/kg fertilizer) is easy for farmers, reflecting input-output; nutrient recovery is physiological, for research. Different scopes, not interchangeable.
map.深施覆土、分期追施、配缓控释肥、有机肥替代部分化肥、优化灌溉（水肥协同）。这些措: Deep placement, split topdressing, slow-release fertilizer, organic substitution, and optimized irrigation (water-fertilizer synergy). These are the main paths of "fertilizer reduction and efficiency".
map.化肥利用率估算器是一款农业种植领域的在线工具。农业种植工具，帮助计算种植参数与产: The Fertilizer Use-Efficiency Estimator is an online agricultural tool that helps calculate planting parameters and yield.
